# korean-word-of-the-day — static word bank and word clock, no external data

## Data owned

| name | kind | database/location | purpose | migration filename |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window.KOREAN_WORDS` | file | `words.js` | word bank for the daily word and word clock views | N/A |

The word bank lives in a global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array in `words.js`. Each entry has `ko`, `roman`, `sound`, `pos`, `meaning`, `syl`, and `ex` fields. The shape mirrors exactly what the Resting Screen design renders, so adding a word is data-only, never a layout change.

The repo reads its own `words.js` file. Rotation of words is deterministic by date, with no API, tokens, or network involved.
